capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Relays Genesis: the 2025 Electrified GV70 had a 77.4 kWh pack (84 kWh from 2026). Years 2023-2025 share the pack (Genesis model notes).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: same 77.4 kWh E-GMP pack as the GV60 (usable 74 kWh on the Weekly Driver pack page, which lists the GV60 but not the GV70).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: same 77.4 kWh E-GMP pack as the GV60 (NCM 811).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: same pack as the GV60: 697 V nominal, 800 V architecture.

preconditioning.notes: Genesis USA owner page for the Electrified GV70: manual Battery Conditioning Mode (EV menu) plus automatic activation when navigating to a fast charger. Page lists no model years; applied to all GV70 EVs.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same E-GMP onboard charger as the GV60 (11 kW AC on the pack page; Hyundai US states 10.9 kW for the same hardware on the Ioniq 5).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same 77.4 kWh pack and charger as the GV60 (233 kW peak on the pack page; Fastned GV60 77.4: 230 kW). Genesis quotes the same 18 min 10-80 % for GV60 and GV70.

published_10_80_min.notes: Relays Genesis: the 2025 GV70 charged 10-80 % in about 18 minutes with a CCS adapter.
